# DipMapper

> DipMapper (dipmapper.com) finds swim spots and water trips anywhere: beaches, lake baths, pools, thermal baths and wild swims near you, with live tides, official EU bathing-water quality, a swim-window forecast, webcams and a wildlife calendar. Free, no account.

## Key pages
- [Live map](https://dipmapper.com/spots): swim spots, beaches, lakes, pools and water activities around any location, with weather, tides, official EU bathing-water quality and routes.
- [Things to do](https://dipmapper.com/explore): 652 hand-picked water experiences worldwide (boat trips, diving, rafting, spas, wildlife) with best months and official links.
- [Beach towns](https://dipmapper.com/waterfront-towns): 141 beach towns and cruise ports, each with best months, beaches, sights, food, nightlife, festivals, seasonal risks, emergency numbers and a climate chart.
- [Trip planner](https://dipmapper.com/plan): pick a beach town and a month – good month or not, climate, festivals, water experiences in season within 150 km, fishing, sunsets and risks.
- [Compare towns](https://dipmapper.com/compare): two or three beach towns side by side.
- Where to go by month: [January](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-january), [February](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-february), [March](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-march), [April](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-april), [May](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-may), [June](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-june), [July](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-july), [August](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-august), [September](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-september), [October](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-october), [November](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-november), [December](https://dipmapper.com/best-beach-towns-in-december) – the beach towns at their best that month.
- [Wildlife calendar](https://dipmapper.com/wildlife-calendar): where and when to see whales, dolphins, seals, turtles, polar bears, salmon and seabirds, with sources.
- [Diving and snorkelling](https://dipmapper.com/diving): seasons, spots, what you see, conditions (level, depth, current), venomous sea life, hotels with a house reef.
- [Shipwrecks](https://dipmapper.com/shipwrecks): famous wrecks on land and under water, with history and preservation.
- [Fishing](https://dipmapper.com/fishing): Swiss lakes, licence rules for ten countries, fly fishing and 23 famous fishing spots worldwide – sorted from the visitor's location.
- [Sunsets, beach bars and drive-on beaches](https://dipmapper.com/beach-life)
- [Sea-risk calendar](https://dipmapper.com/sea-risk-calendar): jellyfish, storm and rough-sea months by region.
- [Sources and licences](https://dipmapper.com/sources) · [Cite and reuse](https://dipmapper.com/cite) · [About](https://dipmapper.com/about)

## How to read the data
- Best months come from published seasons; months that are not documented are not shown as good.
- Water quality is the official EU classification (European Environment Agency), not a DipMapper estimate.
- Forecasts come from MET Norway; climate averages from NASA POWER.

## Terms
